title: Unresolved Record
dek: The gaps, disputed claims, and dangerous unknowns the archive preserves instead of repairing with invention.

facts.Resolution rule: Preserve former uncertainty and append the receipt

sources: Established regional and character histories linked in each research question
Canon clarification · 18 October 2026 · Aria’s denial of siblings was a lie because the subject was too painful.

Canon clarification · 18 October 2026 · Aria was Zarathis’s cultural leader, with influence comparable to a great general alongside its institutions; her authority was distinct from Bowene’s High Lord title.
Quest RP refreshed source · supplied 23 October 2026 · 3,845 messages across the main channel and two accessible threads; posting chronology and narrated continuations remain distinct
body:
The unresolved record tracks what is known, which evidence is missing and where a useful next check could begin. A plausible explanation does not close a question. Dates are source chronology unless a world date is explicitly established.

Some earlier questions are now narrower: the September Hallowing, December restoration work, Saray’s final blow and Bowene’s pre-death title have checked anchors. Their remaining transitions are recorded below. The claim review keeps the conclusions and their limits together.

Gael

Death and return · resolved

How did Nienna return after the July loss?

Known
Original Plains narration confirms Nienna’s death on 9 July 2024. Saray recovers her body and obtains a diamond through an altar offering; Elenia casts Raise Dead on 15 July.
Resolution · 18 October 2026
Ritual and waking scenes first recovered after the owner identified Elenia. The later supplied packet adds direct death narration and the explicit Raise Dead spell record.
Remaining limit
The earlier return gap and spell name are answered. Saray’s guilt and Nienna’s soul-struggle recollection remain attributed.
Next source to check
Retain the death, offering, awakening and casting receipts; keep the September sacrifice distinct.

Death and return · resolved

What brought Elenia back after Wrath?

Known
Gartina casts Reincarnate on Elenia after Wrath’s defeat; she returns still a satyr in the Sanctum on 21 November 2024.
Resolution · 18 October 2026
The post-Wrath return is Gartina’s miracle, not a different unexplained recovery.
Remaining limit
The return scene, caster and date are recovered.
Next source to check
Use the Sanctum sequence for this recovery rather than inventing a separate later return.

Chronology · narrowed

What completes the early restoration chronology?

Known
The first living foothold is described on 2 August 2024. The 5–6 August quest records the consuming shadow, Adelia’s intervention and the luminous tree; September’s Hallowing and December’s staff/forest work remain distinct.
Missing evidence
The exact first casting date and any additional intervening damage or recovery remain incomplete; the August intervention itself is now recovered.
Next source to check
Keep the August quest outcome beside the Hope description, September Hallowing and December scene; do not assign the later transformation to the first living ground.

How large was Hope at each stage?

Known
Player notes disagree between width and radius estimates.
Missing evidence
A dated survey or narrator-defined boundary for the relevant stage.
Next source to check
Original maps or a direct surveyed scene; another estimate cannot resolve the discrepancy.

Restoration · open

What established the forest’s lasting state?

Known
The December seed action and Gartina’s immediate doubt are recorded; later forest activity exists. Akarian explicitly sees trees and life in January 2025, despite his own emotional response.
Missing evidence
A lasting mechanism remains unestablished. The later presence is better corroborated without proving a universal item rule.
Next source to check
December Hope narration and subsequent dated forest scenes.

Zarathis

Leadership · narrowed

When and how did Bowene first become High Lord?

Known
The main quest names Bowene High Lord by 5 August 2025, before Aria’s death. An October council ruling describes consensus followed by the strongest voice if needed.
Missing evidence
The original accession, selection procedure and complete formal powers remain absent from the selected quest/Fein scenes.
Next source to check
An earlier direct appointment or institutional record is still needed. Later use of the title and council practice do not establish his accession.

Review result: Explicit canon clarification separates Aria’s cultural authority from Bowene’s office.

Leadership · narrowed

What was the full scope of the exile judgment?

Known
Bowene requires Elenia to leave, distinguishes exile from banishment, names Aravil and Olokun in the departing company, invites others to join, offers support and sets sunset departure.
Missing evidence
A fixed term, complete geographical jurisdiction and a later completed authorization to return remain unestablished. The companions’ acceptance does not prove identical mandatory sentences.
Next source to check
Any later legal revision or explicit return permission; retain the recovered compromise and voluntary companions separately.

How should the conflicting sibling accounts be understood?

Resolution · 18 October 2026
Explicit canon clarification supplied on 18 October 2026.

Next source to check

Death and return · open

What, if anything, confirms Dumuzi’s later claim about Aria?

Known
The November 2025 quest records Talan killing Aria. In the October 2026 Babel encounter Dumuzi says she is not dead; Olokun challenges why she has not returned to her island.
Still missing
A witnessed living appearance, independently established condition, or a restoration scene and its date and means are absent from this packet.
Next source to check
Check subsequent quest scenes or an explicit owner canon decision. Retain the earlier death and the later claim as different kinds of evidence.

People · open

Which personal transitions still need fuller recovery?

Known
Dale’s July and immediate November returns, Saray’s continued action and later plans, Eugene’s practical learning and repaired friendship, and Casimir/Alioth’s post-trial cooperation now have primary scene anchors.
Still missing

Next source to check
Continue each person’s relevant quest sequences, using compatible RP for relationships and ordinary life. Retain failed plans and do not infer a final fate from absence.

What connects Thorn’s body, ritual and return?

Known
Severina retrieves the body, Ryvyt removes the oil, and Alyhotep begins Wish-based restoration; Thorn is alive by 8 September. The Tower conversation continues with tea, physical weakness, her account of dying and Farkur’s offer of rest.

Mechanism · narrowed

Which effects belong to the Chains, Wasteland and Maw?

Known
The later Chain inspection distinguishes rotting alloy from surviving Delerium, records local movement after a name is whispered, and finds Paco suppressed at approximately the same boundary. The altered guardians and incomplete blight recovery remain separate observations.
Missing evidence
A repeatable explanation separating Chain material, suppression, the Maw’s pull, name effects and the forest’s damage.
Next source to check
Comparable crossings and explicit rulings with conditions recorded; do not turn Ithilrûnë’s revised theory into an established mechanism.

Which observed figures can actually be identified?

Known
Murr recalls a maternal figure but loses the words; Ithilrûnë changes her explanation after studying the Chains. Pappy recalls a rumor with a fuzzy name. No figure’s identity is established by that convergence.
Missing evidence

Babel-Ashur

Environmental threat · open

What would make passage through the western mist reliably safe?

Known
October entry produces personal lures, mistaken identities and paralysis. Scribonia’s ward and nonbreathing Ryvyt resist the visions in this session; breath holding delays exposure. Ryvyt frees Nymera with Dispel Magic before a wider Wish clearing.
Still missing
Reliable exposure limits, the exact protective ward, repeatable treatment, the clearing’s duration, safe routes and the mist’s origin remain unestablished.
Next source to check
Continue the Babel quest after the present cutoff; compare repeated controlled tests with narrator outcomes. Do not infer Spire causation or a sealed rift.

Death and return · narrowed

What completes Nymera’s second August restoration?

Known
The first return is Arjahn’s Revivify. The second attack leaves ashes; Eugene gathers them. Elenia receives them and postpones the attempt until after the mountain operation, then calls Nymera back. September shows her living.
Missing evidence
The checked closing sequence does not name a completed spell or narrate the awakening. The missing transition is bounded by the 29 August attempt and the September living appearance.
Next source to check
A continuation, casting record or explicit ruling for this second return; the existing packet’s closing lines do not supply it.

Larger unresolved questions

  • When and how do higher powers intervene directly?
  • Why must Dumuzi be chosen?
  • What precisely connects the One Tree, Shards, regional Trees and Hope?
  • What was the full mechanism and sequence of the Shattering?
  • What universal rules, if any, govern souls and resurrection?
  • What is Kurayami’s origin?

These remain questions. A public question does not change protected access or turn a speaker’s proposed explanation into objective structure.

How the questions have changed

The first evidence pass narrowed Gael’s restoration into distinct stages and established Bowene’s title before Aria’s death. On 18 October 2026, further scene recovery answered Nienna’s July return, Elenia’s post-Wrath return and Anky’s fatal encounter. The Sanctum transcript also corrected the supposed separate 2026 Miracle: Gartina’s miracle is the same 21 November 2024 return.

The owner clarified that Aria’s sibling denial was a painful lie and that her cultural leadership was distinct from Bowene’s High Lord office. The direct quest fire scene now dates Green Beard’s attack on the Common Man in the source chronology. Thorn’s body recovery, attempted Wish restoration and living presence by 8 September narrow her transition without inventing a missing completion narration.

These resolutions remain beside the questions that preceded them. Later knowledge is appended; it is not assigned retroactively to witnesses in the earlier scenes.

Verdelune

Time and bodily change · open

What caused Pin’s seven-year aging, and can it be reversed?

Known
The narrator records compulsion toward the river and seven years of visible bodily aging despite Ryvyt pulling Pin away. Pin then feels energetic and happy.
Missing evidence
A confirmed cause, duration, reversal or repeatable rule; another traveler’s experience does not establish a universal rate.
Next source to check
A direct examination or later ruling about Pin, compared with crossings whose conditions are recorded.

Bargain and recovery · open

What follows Minerva’s bargain and Selwyn’s release?

Known
The figures release Selwyn’s roots while leaving a branch, and Minerva chooses to accompany them under concealed conditions. She later reports herself safe with entry to Nerithra.
Missing evidence
The actual ritual and its effects, Minerva’s eventual return, and Selwyn’s condition after retrieval.
Next source to check
The missing continuation, a witnessed return or direct examination; her reassurance alone cannot supply the ritual.
